subject: GCP Marketplace procurement & onboarding: invoice routing + canary listing plan
messages:
From: Elena Park <procurement@datariver.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP listing procurement kickoff: invoice routing & canary plan

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for the product overview yesterday — DataRiver is excited to get Redwood listed in our GCP procurement catalog. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items so our internal finance and legal can start the PO and contract routing:

- Billing contact (name + email) for invoice routing and W-9 if needed
- Preferred invoice cadence (monthly vs net-30) and remittance address
- Any billing alias or vendor code we should reference on the PO
- Confirmation of SOC 2 availability for our audit team

We also want to run a short canary (two-week) listing in our internal sandbox project before the general availability listing goes live — mainly to validate billing events and entitlement flows. Can you share the canary runbook or a short checklist for the engineering steps and the billing event expectations?

I've attached our PO stub (datariver-po-4519.pdf) for context.

Appreciate a quick sync — procurement is targeting to have all paperwork started by next Wednesday (2026-08-26).

Thanks,
Elena Park
Senior Procurement Manager
DataRiver Analytics
procurement@datariver.ai

Attachment: datariver-po-4519.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <procurement@datariver.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing procurement kickoff: invoice routing & canary plan

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the PO.

Short answers up front:
- Billing contact: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com) — she'll confirm remit details and W-9.
- Invoice cadence: default is monthly; we can support net-30 on contract.
- Billing alias: please reference vendor code REDW-00083 on the PO.
- SOC 2: yes — SOC 2 Type II summary attached (soc2-audit-summary.pdf). Full report available under NDA; we can route that to your audit team via secure link.

For the canary listing: attaching a short canary runbook (canary-runbook-v1.md) and a procurement routing matrix (procure-routing-matrix.xlsx) that maps which events trigger billing and who owns retries/fallbacks. High-level canary plan:
- Week 0 (prep): exchange service account keys, register sandbox SKU, and set billing alias.
- Week 1 (smoke): 10 internal seats, synthetic billing transactions to validate meter firing and invoice line items.
- Week 2 (load): scale to 100 internal seats, confirm quota and entitlement handling, finalize billing threshold alerts.

Next steps I propose: 1) Vanessa (billing) confirms remit address + W-9; 2) Laura and Marcus own DOC/contract intake for DocuSign; 3) schedule a 30-min tech/billing sync Monday 11:00am PT to walk the runbook.

I'll draft a HubSpot deal note and create a Jira ticket for the canary — will share links after this thread.

— Karthik
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary-runbook-v1.md (text/markdown), procure-routing-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), soc2-audit-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <procurement@datariver.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing procurement kickoff: invoice routing & canary plan

Elena — quick note from the contracts side.

We can accept DataRiver's standard PO as long as the vendor code and remit details match our records. A few contract housekeeping items we would like to align on before DocuSign:
- Standard Redwood EULA + Marketplace Addendum (I'll attach redlines if needed)
- Billing contact and who signs the SOW (if any professional services are added)
- Term/renewal language for listing pricing and metering parity

Tom (finance) — if you can confirm whether DataRiver needs our W-9 as a PDF on file or if electronic remit via Bill.com is preferred, that helps speed the intake.

I can prepare a DocuSign envelope for the marketplace addendum once Vanessa confirms remit details.

Thanks,
Laura
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: marketplace-addendum-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Tom Wu <finance@datariver.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <procurement@datariver.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing procurement kickoff: invoice routing & canary plan

Hi Laura / Karthik,

Thanks — procurement confirmed the PO number and the billing team prefers electronic invoice delivery (Bill.com). Please use billing alias REDW-00083 on all invoices. Our AP team requires invoices to include:
- PO number (4519)
- Line-level SKU description and unit price
- Remit to: DataRiver Analytics / AP Team / ap@datariver.ai

On SOC 2: procurement is fine with the summary; audit team will request the full report via your secure delivery link if needed.

We also want to confirm the canary dates. Proposed: 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-20 (two weeks). Please confirm your engineering/ops run window and any blackout dates.

Tom Wu
Director of Finance, DataRiver Analytics

Attachment: datariver-ap-invoice-guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <procurement@datariver.ai>, Tom Wu <finance@datariver.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing procurement kickoff: invoice routing & canary plan

Great — thanks for the rapid responses and the PO. Confirming next steps and owners:
1) Vanessa: will send W-9 and remit confirmation to ap@datariver.ai by EOD Monday.
2) Laura: will prepare marketplace addendum and a DocuSign envelope; expects a <24h review turnaround.
3) Marcus: will open Jira ticket MKTPL-3124 for the canary engineering tasks and share the link; will coordinate sandbox service account access with your infra contact.
4) We confirm canary window 2026-09-07 → 2026-09-20. We'll aim to keep traffic synthetic first 3 days, then scale as described in the runbook.

I've created the HubSpot deal and added notes (link below). I'll also attach the procurement matrix and the SOC 2 summary to the deal record. Please reply with any blocked items but otherwise consider this plan green.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DR-2026-0841
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKTPL-3124

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the canary.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
